pages.title: Lorentz Transform Crystal
pages.text: The rules for how space and time look to someone moving at a different speed: lengths contract, clocks slow and simultaneity stops being universal. This crystal is moving near light speed in some frame, and in mine it appears squashed, its internal clocks ticking visibly slowly.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Entangled photons gave me a clock that always moved at light speed; tachyon flux gave me one that moved faster. The Tensor Calculus Engine found the transformation that kept the speed of light the same for both.
